episodes.synopsis: Hakuno feels a rage build up inside of him as he lives through the repetitive virtual world of SE.RA.PH, and it fills him with a sense of purpose.
episodes.title: Praeteritus Limbus Vorago

episodes.synopsis: Saber proudly introduces herself and prepares Hakuno for the war ahead. But finding another Master to battle proves to be harder than anticipated.
episodes.title: Dead Face

episodes.synopsis: Hakuno and Saber meet Rin, a self-proclaimed Resistor. Hakuno learns that he must kill Shinji, the Floor Master, in order to ascend to the next level.
episodes.title: Golden Wild Hunt

episodes.synopsis: After making it to the next level, Hakuno and Saber are immediately ambushed. Just as things seem hopeless, they meet a stranger named Rani VIII.
episodes.title: No Face May King

episodes.synopsis: Rani VIII tells Hakuno about the Floor Master, Dan Blackmore, and they learn why he can never ascend -- no matter how many lives he takes.
episodes.title: Yew Bow

episodes.synopsis: After ascending to the mysterious third level, Hakuno meets Alice, a cyber ghost living alone in this haunted wonderland.
episodes.title: The Queen's Glass Game

episodes.synopsis: The only way out of the time loop they're trapped in is to defeat Alice. Hakuno is hesitant, despite knowing how many she's killed before.
episodes.title: Nursery Rhyme

episodes.synopsis: Rin gets them ready for the fifth level, where a Berserker wanders. There’s no floor master, but something perhaps much worse.
episodes.title: Bajiquan

episodes.synopsis: A familiar-looking girl also named Hakuno Kishinami appears. Later, Saber tells the male Hakuno that she's ready to take on the Berserker once again.
episodes.title: Aestus Domus Aurea

episodes.synopsis: Now on the sixth floor, Hakuno and Saber are suddenly attacked by a swarm of beings who look just like Rin and Rani.
episodes.title: Unlimited/Raise Dead

episodes.synopsis: Hakuno and Saber reach the final floor, where a thousand years ago, a previous incarnation of Hakuno defeated the Master before perishing.
episodes.title: Excalibur Galatine

episodes.synopsis: Now back on the lowest floor, it seems as if Hakuno and Saber have to start all over again -- and they're running out of time.
episodes.title: Chakravartin

episodes.synopsis: At long last, the final battle begins. Hakuno’s ultimate opponent reveals his identity and the reasons for constructing this war.
episodes.title: Olympia Plaudere
